maddeler.e:
يكتنفون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَنِفُونَ (yaktanifūna) /jak.ta.ni.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# يُكْتَنَفُونَ (yuktanafūna) /juk.ta.na.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
